  - heading "Summary" [level=2]
  - text: Generated · 30-second read
  - paragraph: Executive overview of what this item covers, key takeaways, and how its timeline and scope affect freight operations.
  - paragraph: Regulation (EU) 2024/1157 of 11 April 2024 on shipments of waste repeals Regulation (EC) No 1013/2006 and sets procedures and controls for waste moved between Member States and imported into, exported from or in transit through the Union. It applies from 21 May 2026, with most export rules from 21 May 2027, and is enforced by Member State authorities.
  - paragraph: Why it matters
  - paragraph: Since 21 May 2026 prior-consent procedures run electronically through the Commission's central system, with the paper route allowed for green-listed waste only until 31 December 2026. From 21 November 2026 exports of plastic waste under entry B3011 to countries outside the OECD Decision are prohibited, and from 21 May 2027 non-hazardous waste can go only to listed countries. Carriers and those arranging a shipment must keep the documents in the vehicle when they cannot be shown online, and inspectors can detain waste and the means of transport until documents are produced. Penalties are set by the Member States and include fines, loss of authorisation and exclusion from public procurement.
  - paragraph: What it changes
  - paragraph: Electronic waste-shipment procedures apply since 21 May 2026; plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries are banned from 21 November 2026 and wider export rules start 21 May 2027.
  - paragraph: Key data
  - paragraph: Regulation applies from 21 May 2026; export rules from 21 May 2027
  - paragraph: Plastic waste under entry B3011 may not be exported to countries outside the OECD Decision from 21 November 2026
  - paragraph: Paper procedure for green-listed waste allowed until 31 December 2026
  - paragraph: Documents must be available in the vehicle when they cannot be shown online
  - paragraph: Trajectory
  - text: Regulation applies; electronic procedures start (May 21 2026) →
  - strong: plastic waste B3011 export to non-OECD countries prohibited (Nov 21 2026)
  - text: → paper procedure for green-listed waste ends (Dec 31 2026) → export audit duty and non-hazardous export rules apply (May 21 2027)

The Commission confirms it for a wider group: «exports of plastic waste from the EU to non-OECD countries will be banned»."
